annotations.title: Book a call with Mike Fluff

description: SIDE EFFECT: books a real 30-minute video call in Mike Fluff's calendar, emails a confirmation with a calendar invite to the given address, alerts Mike, and records the booking as a lead. Only call this when the user has explicitly asked to book and chosen the time. "slot" must be one of the exact values returned by get_booking_slots. Name and email: either the ones the user gave for this purpose, or leave them out and the call is booked in the name of the person signed in with INITE ID (OAuth scope "mikefluff:booking"; without a token such a call is answered with HTTP 401 and the client is sent to sign in). Topics: diagnostic (general business consultation), automation (AI automation), compliance (privacy/GDPR/LGPD around AI systems), architect-mode (the one-day intensive). The confirmation email has a link to move or cancel. Limited to 3 bookings per hour per caller and 2 upcoming calls per email.

email.description: The user's email; the confirmation goes there. Omit to use the signed-in account's email.

message.description: Optional: what the user wants to discuss, in their words.

name.description: The user's name, as they gave it. Omit to use the signed-in account's name.

slot.description: Exact ISO 8601 start time from get_booking_slots, e.g. 2026-10-20T13:00:00.000Z.

timeZone.description: Optional IANA time zone of the user (e.g. America/Sao_Paulo) for the email's times.
